# Introduction

This document records the ongoing investigation of magnetic switchbacks observed by NASA's Parker Solar Probe.

# Scientific Background

## Magnetic Switchbacks

Magnetic switchbacks are large rotations of the magnetic-field vector, sometimes including reversals of its radial component.

The magnetic-field magnitude is defined as:

$$
|\mathbf{B}| = \sqrt{B_R^2 + B_T^2 + B_N^2}
$$
